name: Glass retention graph
oneLiner: an audience retention card on glass: the curve draws itself with a lit area under it, a dip and a spike get timestamp chips as the line reaches them, then a playhead rides the curve from the left and snaps onto the spike, the band behind it lights and the spike chip lifts
say: when the speaker talks about where viewers dropped off or rewatched ('everyone left at the two minute mark', 'this is the part people replayed'): the dip chip lands on 'left', the playhead snaps to the spike on 'replayed'
